notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR15: "DEBUG-CONTENTS is a data item that is large enough to contain the data required by the following general rules." ProcedureTableBuilder widens _debugContentsWidth to each data target's whole-occurrence image (AddDebugDataTarget, RecordLayout.AllOccurrencesImageWidth), each cd-name's area (AddDebugCdTarget), each file's record area (AddDebugFileTarget) and each ALTER procedure-name-2 (FinalizeDebug), and DebugItem.ContentsWidth keeps it at least 30; the register exists only at --std 85 (COBOL0902 at 2002/2023). Probes at 85: a 400-character group holding OCCURS 1 TO 40 DEPENDING ON (DEBUG-CONTENTS (396:5) = ENDOK); a RECORD VARYING 5 TO 300 file (positions 296-300 of the long record read, spaces after the short one); an S9(18) item at -999999999999999999 and ZERO (its 18-character storage image). The witness checks a 200-character item, a 1-character item and a 150-character record.

next.reason: 1985: "DEBUG-CONTENTS is a data item that is large enough to contain the data required by the following general rules."; 2023: "No candidate covers DEBUG-CONTENTS or USE FOR DEBUGGING; the 2023 USE statement rules list no debugging phrase.". The 2023 USE statement rules cover exception, I-O and report declaratives only. None mentions DEBUG-CONTENTS or debugging declaratives, so the Debug module feature is dropped.
